test_title: PYST 69: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements: **All rocks are ships. Some ships are tables. All pots are tables.

**Conclusion I:** Some pots are rocks.

**Conclusion II: **Some pots are ships.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows
Both Conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

All rocks are ships.**
Some ships are tables.

All pots are tables.

**Venn Diagram Logic:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1af001c60c02818fdbe3915ae6867e70fc4822e5a2532d6965deb5825de684.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some pots are rocks → Does not follows **(Because there is no definite relation between pots and rocks.)

(II) Some pots are ships → **Does not follows **(Because there is no definite relation between pots and ships.)

Therefore, neither Conclusion I nor II follows.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".**
